shots.subject: A standing traveler seen from behind and the same reflection already facing camera inside smoked glass.
shots.action: The reflection finishes one blink before the traveler stops at the yellow inspection line.
shots.movement: Traveler coat settles naturally; reflected shoulders settle 500 milliseconds early; mercury rim climbs against gravity.
shots.framing: Vertical medium-wide with traveler centered low and waiting reflection centered high inside the panel.
shots.lens_behavior: Slow five-percent optical push with straight architectural lines and no digital warp.
shots.lighting: Overhead cream fluorescents; amber CRT catchlights appear only in reflected eyes.
shots.weather: Upward condensation pauses during the early blink.
sound_cues: Music drops for 600 milliseconds.
One polite descending warning chime.
shots.transition: Hard optical splice on the reflection's completed blink.
negative_constraints: No extra people or duplicate bodies outside glass.

shots.subject: The physical twelve-meter Annex and its reflection extending as a kilometer-long terminal.
shots.action: Amber counter 001 advances while one teal floor tile telescopes out of the physical corridor.
shots.movement: Rubber walkway moves toward camera; reflected walkway remains fixed; condensation travels upward.
shots.framing: Extreme vertical wide showing traveler as a small figure beneath nine mirror panels.
shots.lens_behavior: Deep-focus 24-millimeter geometry with reflected vanishing point impossibly distant but structurally straight.
shots.lighting: Cream ceiling baffles alternate with amber pools; mirror depth falls into cyan haze.
shots.weather: Ozone draft lifts a paper corner toward a closed window.
sound_cues: Six-hertz walkway thrum.
CRT relay clicks before number change.
shots.transition: Iris down into a Bureau diagram circle.

shots.subject: Cream field diagram of traveler, mirror plane, ninety-degree viewing cone, and a second amber timeline cursor.
shots.action: The amber reflected cursor advances 500 milliseconds ahead, borrows one DECISION token, then stops.
shots.movement: Mechanical vector arrows step in four discrete optical-printer increments.
shots.framing: Flat full-frame diagram with captions protected in the middle sixty percent.
shots.lens_behavior: No perspective; slight gate weave limited to two pixels.
shots.lighting: Even cel illumination with amber phosphor bloom around the early cursor.
shots.weather: Not applicable; visible dust moves only between optical layers.
sound_cues: Dry relay ticks for each diagram step.
Soft vibraphone note under DECISION token.
shots.transition: Diagram's teal cone becomes the floor's yellow inspection wedge.

shots.subject: Grainy Bureau training footage of a 1960s traveler waving toward an already-seated reflection.
shots.action: A gloved clerk stamps ACKNOWLEDGED across the frame before the traveler's hand reaches shoulder height.
shots.movement: Hand-cranked footage jitters at eighteen frames per second while stamp animation remains perfectly steady.
shots.framing: Square archival insert within a rounded CRT bezel and teal inspection labels.
shots.lens_behavior: Slight edge softness, halation on white gloves, stable human proportions.
shots.lighting: Flat institutional tungsten with silver flare confined to mirror edges.
shots.weather: Film dust and one vertical emulsion scratch; no digital noise.
sound_cues: Projector sprocket chatter.
Muted rubber stamp impact.
shots.transition: Stamped diagonal becomes the traveler's sideways path arrow.
negative_constraints: No imitation of a known film or television property.

shots.subject: Close detail of the traveler's eye crossing out of the silver viewing cone while the reflected eye stays amber-lit.
shots.action: The physical pupil exits frame; the reflected pupil tracks once, then freezes.
shots.movement: One deliberate lateral head movement; condensation beads climb across glass in the opposite direction.
shots.framing: Split composition: physical eye at left edge, two-millimeter mercury meniscus and reflected eye at right.
shots.lens_behavior: Ninety-millimeter macro with shallow depth isolated on eyelashes, glass edge, and amber catchlight.
shots.lighting: Soft cream cheek light and narrow amber rectangle reflected in the iris.
shots.weather: Condensation rises at constant speed along the panel seam.
sound_cues: Room tone narrows to one fluorescent ballast hum.
Soft shoe slide on tile.
shots.transition: Three circular catchlights become three numbered blink-verifier lenses.
negative_constraints: No contact between skin and glass.

shots.subject: A three-lens blink verifier beside the traveler and a frozen reflection in ribbed inspection glass.
shots.action: Three lenses illuminate in sequence as the traveler performs blinks the reflection fails to anticipate.
shots.movement: Mechanical iris leaves close and reopen; reflected face remains one frame behind after each success.
shots.framing: Medium profile with verifier foreground, traveler midground, reflection isolated behind ribbed glass.
shots.lens_behavior: Forty-millimeter lens with crisp layered depth and no rack-focus ambiguity.
shots.lighting: Each verified blink changes one lens from amber to teal.
shots.weather: Dry ozone draft moves one loose hair only after the third blink.
sound_cues: Three polite relay clicks.
Major-second synth resolves on third blink.
shots.transition: Third teal lens match-cuts to graphite fibers in Form R-9.
negative_constraints: No reflection moving after containment indication.

shots.subject: Salmon Form R-9 held edge-first by one hand before the mercury-rimmed mirror and a graphite pencil on aluminum.
shots.action: The form slides into a reflected-only drawer while fingers remain four centimeters from glass.
shots.movement: Paper advances in one straight plane; graphite fibers flash white in reflection but stay matte outside.
shots.framing: Top-down instructional close shot with measurement ticks showing the four-centimeter hand clearance.
shots.lens_behavior: Fifty-millimeter orthographic-like view with controlled paper texture and legible form headings.
shots.lighting: Cool desk strip reveals graphite fibers; amber mirror light outlines the edge.
shots.weather: Ozone draft lifts only the unreflected corner of the form.
sound_cues: Graphite scratches once.
Aluminum drawer glides without impact.
shots.transition: Drawer's black slot expands into the dark Identity Holding Gallery.

shots.subject: The physical traveler stands at the threshold while the reflection sits alone in a chrome chair climbing the wall.
shots.action: Amber ORIGINAL RETURN claim lights activate from floor to ceiling behind the seated reflection.
shots.movement: Reflection crosses one ankle without corresponding body motion; empty chair heat-shadows bloom upward.
shots.framing: Low traveler silhouette anchors bottom; chair rows rotate through ninety degrees above the reflected figure.
shots.lens_behavior: Twenty-eight-millimeter rise with straight chrome rails and gravity shift expressed only by chair orientation.
shots.lighting: Amber claim lights chase upward; teal spill keeps traveler readable without horror silhouette.
shots.weather: Ozone haze forms horizontal layers despite rotated chairs.
sound_cues: Chair vinyl releases one soft sigh.
Warning chime repeats at half speed.
shots.transition: Amber sign extinguishes to a cream Bureau classification card.

shots.subject: Traveler from behind remains standing while the matching reflection is seated beneath amber NOW SERVING 001 and looks over one shoulder.
shots.action: The reflection raises Form R-9 just below its dated Bureau badge; physical traveler keeps both hands visible.
shots.movement: Only amber counter phosphor flickers; figures hold a clean readable pose for thumbnail extraction.
shots.framing: Vertical two-figure paradox with clean upper caption band, traveler silhouette low, reflected face and badge unobstructed.
shots.lens_behavior: Fifty-millimeter normal perspective with exact mirrored clothing geometry and no exaggerated depth.
shots.lighting: Cream key on physical shoulders; amber reflected key separates face, form, and badge.
shots.weather: One upward condensation trail frames but does not cross the reflected face.
sound_cues: Music thins to vibraphone and room tone.
CRT counter buzz remains steady.
shots.transition: Form R-9 lowers, revealing synchronized feet at the inspection line.
negative_constraints: No caption over face or badge.
No threatening expression or horror lighting.

shots.subject: Traveler shoes and reflected shoes align on opposite sides of the yellow inspection line beside a teal containment lamp.
shots.action: Both sets of footsteps land together; the mercury edge settles downward and the lamp changes from amber to teal.
shots.movement: One synchronized step, natural sole compression, then complete stillness except film gate weave.
shots.framing: Low close-wide shows physical and reflected feet, line markings, panel edge, and containment lamp.
shots.lens_behavior: Thirty-five-millimeter lens with deep focus from shoe tread to reflected grout lines.
shots.lighting: Teal containment lamp replaces amber spill without changing material colors.
shots.weather: Condensation resumes downward for the first time.
sound_cues: Two footsteps resolve as one.
Synth major second settles into a single tone.
shots.transition: Teal lamp circle becomes a Bureau seal on cream stock.

shots.subject: Cream Bureau seal card beside an inspection photograph where the contained reflection's enamel badge reads BY 32.
shots.action: A graphite underline appears beneath the badge date, followed by the Bureau tagline in optical type.
shots.movement: End-card layers settle with moderate gate weave; the photograph reflection remains still except one final amber eye catchlight.
shots.framing: Seal at lower left, badge evidence upper right, centered caption-safe tagline.
shots.lens_behavior: Flat optical composite with crisp evidence inset and moderate readable analog wear.
shots.lighting: Even cream card illumination; restrained amber phosphor bloom on the anomalous date.
shots.weather: Two dust flecks cross the optical layer without obscuring text.
sound_cues: Warm baritone remains dry and centered.
Final polite chime leaves a short tape tail.
